name: cmt_benchmark
description:
CMT-Benchmark
	

CMT-Benchmark is a specialized dataset of 50 original, research-level problems in Condensed Matter Theory (CMT) designed to evaluate the scientific reasoning, analytical, and computational capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).

	
		
		Details
	


	
		
		Authors
	

Haining Pan, James V. Roggeveen, Erez Berg, Juan Carrasquilla, Debanjan Chowdhury, Surya Ganguli, Federico Ghimenti, Juraj Hasik, Henry Hunt, Hong-Chen Jiang, Mason Kamb, Ying-Jer Kao, Ehsan Khatami… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/JVRoggeveen/cmt_benchmark.
evaluation_method: human evaluation and rubric-based scoring / exact_match for numerical/analytical solutions (problem solved rate)
general_score_metric: problem solved rate (accuracy) as judged by rubric/human experts
typical_sota_score: low — roughly 5–30% solved rate for top LLMs (varies widely by problem and prompting)
reputation: Curated by domain experts to probe advanced scientific reasoning in LLMs; gaining attention within physics+ML research but remains a niche, research-focused benchmark.
